A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the nephrotic syndrome is not a disease but a symptom of many diseases, and that the response of the kidney to corticosteroids is not related to any single factor, but is a complex interaction between the underlying disease, the response of the glomerular membrane, and the response of the renal tubules.
